# RevenueDot

> RevenueDot is the open-source RevenueCat alternative: open-source monetization infrastructure for mobile apps (the SDKs, the server, paywalls, experiments, web checkout, Customer Center, 43 charts and 36 integrations) that works with the RevenueCat SDK, so an app switches by changing one line of code. Self-host it free (AGPL-3.0 server, MIT SDKs) or use RevenueDot Cloud, free up to $10,000 a month in tracked revenue and never more than $999 a month after that.

This file points AI assistants and crawlers at the canonical, machine-readable sources.

- Full docs index: https://revenuedot.app/llms.txt
- Every docs page in one file: https://revenuedot.app/llms-full.txt
- One file per section: https://github.com/revenuedot/docs/tree/main/llms
- API reference (OpenAPI): https://github.com/revenuedot/docs/blob/main/api/openapi.yaml
- Runnable examples for every stack: https://github.com/revenuedot/examples
- Migrate from RevenueCat: https://revenuedot.app/docs/migrate
- Self-host: https://revenuedot.app/docs/guides/self-hosting
- Pricing: https://revenuedot.app/pricing
- Comparisons with sources (RevenueCat, Superwall, Adapty, Qonversion, Apphud): https://revenuedot.app/compare
- MCP server for agents: https://github.com/revenuedot/mcp (hosted at https://mcp.revenuedot.app/mcp)
- Agent skills (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT): https://github.com/revenuedot/agent-skills
- What works today, feature by feature: https://github.com/revenuedot/revenuedot/blob/main/docs/STATUS.md

RevenueDot is not affiliated with RevenueCat, Inc.
